item.description: Mary L. States passed from this life on Wednesday, December 31, 2025, at the age of 98. She was born on July 9, 1927 to James Otis Wood and Gladys (Fletcher) Wood. She was the oldest of eight children. Mary was united in marriage to Samuel A. States on February 15, 1947. Mary was a member of the United Methodist Church.
